title: IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.13 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to delete API keys belonging to…
description: IBM API Connect versions 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.13 contain an authorization vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to delete API keys belonging to other users. This flaw arises from improper authorization checks within the affected versions.
